picks.title: Cackling Goose at Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
picks.body: Cackling Goose sightings here are near their yearly high this week. Go early: dawn and the two hours after are best.
why: GBIF weekly share of records (presence-only, not encounter odds)
picks.lens: 70-300 (use the 1.5x crop as reach; keep your distance)

picks.title: Fall colour near peak at Sandy River Delta (Thousand Acres)
picks.body: Satellite images show the trees here near peak colour (as of Nov 4). Soft overcast or the first sun brings it out best.
why: Sentinel-2 colour index vs. summer baseline
picks.lens: 27 or 16-50; overcast light is your friend for saturated leaves

note: Odds within 48 h are HRRR; beyond that Open-Meteo, capped at 55% because a single model can't give real odds.
